findings.title: Conflicting Delivery Timelines for Imaging Services
findings.fact: Section 7.14 requires delivery within 45 calendar days of receipt of Purchase Order. Section 7.17 states that for customized imaging, the Contractor must deliver the remainder of imaged units within 30 calendar days from approval of the test unit, but also states 'Notwithstanding the foregoing in this clause the delivery date shall not be required to be less than 45 days from date of Purchase Order.' These provisions reconcile as follows: the delivery date is the later of (i) 30 calendar days from the Authorized User's written approval of the test unit, and (ii) 45 calendar days from the date of the Purchase Order. The 'notwithstanding' clause establishes a 45-day floor but does not override the 30-day deadline if approval occurs so late that 30 days from approval exceeds 45 days from PO.
findings.business_implication: Bidders should calculate the delivery date based on the later of the two deadlines to avoid underpromising and potential disputes.
findings.action_recommendation: No clarification needed; the clauses can be interpreted as a 45-day minimum with the 30-day-from-approval deadline applying only if it is later. Bidders should document their understanding in their proposal to avoid disputes.

quotes.quote: The Contractor shall deliver the units ordered by an Authorized User within 45 calendar days of receipt of a Purchase Order, approved by OSC if applicable, unless either the Authorized User or OGS grants an extension of time as provided below.

If an Authorized User requires customized factory imaging, the Contractor shall provide a test unit with the customized image within five (5) business days of receiving the Authorized User’s image. The Contractor must deliver the remainder of the imaged units ordered by the Authorized User, within 30 calendar days from the date of Authorized User’s written approval of the test unit. Notwithstanding the foregoing in this clause the delivery date shall not be required to be less than 45 days from date of Purchase Order.

findings.title: Liability for Extended Participating Entities
findings.fact: In the event that any resulting Agreement is extended to other States or governmental jurisdictions, such other authorized entities shall be solely responsible for liability and performance under any resulting Agreement and Contractor agrees to hold them solely responsible for such liability and performance.
findings.business_implication: The bidder may be exposed to liability for actions of extended entities, but the clause attempts to shift responsibility to those entities. However, the bidder must ensure that the extended entities are indeed solely responsible and that the bidder is not held liable by third parties.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the clause carefully and consider seeking clarification on how liability is allocated in practice, especially if the bidder is expected to enforce this provision.

quotes.quote: In the event that any resulting Agreement is so extended, such other authorized entities shall be solely responsible for liability and performance under any resulting Agreement and Contractor agrees to hold them solely responsible for such liability and performance.

findings.title: Delivery Timeframe for Imaging Services
findings.fact: Page 18 requires delivery of imaged units within 30 calendar days of Authorized User's written approval of the test unit, but states that the delivery date shall not be required to be less than 45 days from the date of Purchase Order. Page 17 generally requires delivery within 45 calendar days of receipt of a Purchase Order, unless an extension is granted.
findings.business_implication: The clauses are not truly contradictory. For imaging orders, the contractor is not required to deliver earlier than 45 days from the PO, but must deliver within 30 days of test-unit approval if that date is later than 45 days from the PO. This preserves the contractor's minimum lead time while accommodating the customized imaging process.
findings.action_recommendation: No clarification is necessary. Contractors should calculate the delivery deadline for customized imaging as the later of 30 days from test-unit approval and 45 days from the PO, and document this interpretation to avoid disputes.
